name: UI Workbench
author: Edgemodders
description: Inspect the game's own UI (its ink layers and HUD pieces as a tree, any widget's class, path, box, controllers, source file and properties, and Pick under the cursor), and write native UI of your own: projects of ink markup and a script, run live in the game. Inspect reads only; Edit and Projects need the admin permission, to run your projects. Part of REDnode UI Tools.
